name: TS6-Manager-Frontend
description: TS6 Manager Frontend - web UI of the TS6 Manager stack for managing TeamSpeak servers in the browser: dashboard, channels, clients, permissions, music bots, visual bot flow editor and embeddable server widgets. STACK: Requires TS6-Manager-Backend (API on host port 3001). nginx in this container proxies /api and /ws to backend:3001, which the --add-host entry maps to the MOS host. FIRST START: open http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:3000/setup to create the admin account.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Web interface (nginx). Point your reverse proxy here.
